sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (illustrations show ₹25,00,000; actual options per policy schedule)

room_rent.note: Clause 3.1.1(iii)(a) explicitly states 'no sub-limit' on Room/Boarding and nursing expenses. Optional Cover 8 can restrict this to Single Private Room if opted.

icu.note: Clause 3.1.1(iii)(b) explicitly states 'no sub-limit' on ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base policy. Optional Cover 6 allows insured to voluntarily opt a co-payment for premium discount. Optional Cover 4 (Smart Select) imposes 20% co-pay if treatment taken outside listed hospitals.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure sub-limits stated in the base policy wording.

deductible.note: Optional Cover 3 allows policyholder to opt a deductible for a premium discount; deductible amount per policy schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Cover 5 reduces it to 24 months.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 15 categories of specific diseases/procedures listed (e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement, arthritis, ENT surgeries, etc.) have a 24-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Code Excl18). No optional maternity cover offered in this product.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 50% (base NCB) + up to 100% (NCB Super add-on)
cumulative_bonus.note: Base Benefit 5: 10%/yr, max 50% of SI. Optional Cover 1 (NCB Super): additional 50%/yr, max 100% of SI, cumulative max 150% combined. In event of claim, bonus reduces at same rate it accrued.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of base SI (same & different illness)
restoration.note: Benefit 6 (Automatic Recharge): reinstates base SI once per policy year after full exhaustion; usable for same or different illness. Optional Cover 11 (Unlimited Automatic Recharge) extends this to unlimited times.

pre_hosp.note: Optional Cover 13 can extend this period as specified in policy schedule.

post_hosp.note: Optional Cover 13 can extend this period as specified in policy schedule.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (541 procedures in Annexure I)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization is defined in the policy but no benefit clause covers it as an inbuilt or optional benefit.

ayush.note: Benefit 7: AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured at AYUSH hospitals; must be inpatient-admissible claim.

organ_donor.note: Benefit 4: Medical expenses of organ donor covered up to amount in policy schedule.

ambulance.note: Benefit 3: Road ambulance covered up to amount specified in policy schedule. Optional Cover 2 adds Air Ambulance cover.

modern_treatments.note: Clause 3.1.1(iv) lists 12 advance technology methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered under Benefit 1.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-medical/consumable items as excluded. No optional consumables cover offered.

global_cover.note: Clause 6.1.7(a) states policy covers only medical treatment taken entirely within India.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (excl.), infertility/ART, domiciliary not covered, hazardous sports (professional), tobacco/alcohol-related illness, hormone replacement therapy, external congenital anomaly
optional_riders: NCB Super (50%/yr extra bonus), Air Ambulance, Deductible option, Smart Select (network discount), PED wait reduction to 24mo, Co-pay option, Annual Health Check-up, Room Rent cap to Single Private, Daily Allowance, Accidental SI doubler, Unlimited Recharge, Unlimited e-Consultations, Pre-Post Hosp period extension
